evaluation_design: Six fictional cases per edition, frozen before execution; separate executor without oracle; one AI case author also judged outputs.
protocol_limitation: Executor read all 12 requests and metadata in one context, not the intended case-isolated prompts.
causal_attribution: No old-skill or no-skill baseline, repeated sampling, independent human ratings, or general improvement estimate.
meaning_of_pass: No material case failure under this single evaluation; correctly marked author decisions can pass without publication-ready copy.
helper_scope: Surface checker was not used during behavioral execution; helper tests do not measure semantics or clarity.
overfitting: Not ruled out. No guarantee of generalization or absence of overfitting.
